title: NASA Scientists Show How Gravitational Waves Can Reveal New Worlds
caption:
NASA's upcoming LISA mission will hunt for exoplanets by listening for ripples in space-time. By detecting how a planet’s gravity pulls on a pair of dead stars, researchers can identify worlds that are invisible to traditional telescopes.

Source: Science - NASA Scientists Show How Gravitational Waves Can Reveal New Worlds

https://science.nasa.gov/missions/lisa/gravitational-waves-can-reveal-new-worlds/
